query_set_note: Thirty seed evaluation questions drafted against the bundled corpus and manifest. Review relevant_doc_ids before using scores to justify a production setting; this is not an independently judged test set.

evaluation.retriever: Production HybridRetriever: Chroma cosine search plus BM25, combined by RRF; BM25-only baseline also reported.
evaluation.vector_store: Chroma in a temporary directory per configuration; the repository's persistent vector database is not modified.
evaluation.query_labels: seed labels; manually review before interpreting as ground truth
evaluation.access_filter: Role, region, and reference date are applied. The production chat keyword-relevance filter is also applied.
evaluation.metric_unit: unique relevant document IDs among top-k retrieved chunks
